name: Rust Interprocedural Summary Manifests
description: C06 declared summary route demo: the in-process Rust analyzer emits a declared mumei.rust-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest for a two-function unit, the reuse check partitions functions as reusable, and the strict whole-context accept gate echoes one function's declared summary.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the declared rust-summaries route family end to end: emit the summary manifest, verify it against a fresh derivation, and accept one function under the strict whole-context gate.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/rust_summaries/demo_counter.rs and the sibling mumei-agent rust-summaries route commands.
No toolchain step: the analyzer runs in-process on tree-sitter, so every step is deterministic and none is SKIPPED for a missing external tool.
Generate evidence: emit_manifest.log, check_manifest.log, accept_summary.log, manifest.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
Gate order: emit -> check -> accept; the check and accept steps consume only the manifest the emit step wrote, never the fresh derivation directly.
The emitted manifest is declared data: check re-derives summaries and partitions reusable/stale/missing functions, and accept refuses anything but an exact context match.
notes: The Rust analyzer is source-analysis infrastructure, not a verifier; the demo routes it only through the declared rust-summaries family.
Every step runs the real route commands — the analyzer needs no provisioned toolchain, so no step fabricates output and no fixture payloads are recorded.
The accept step names a function (--function add): manifest keys are function names, so editing demo_counter.rs cannot silently desync a recorded payload.
budget_policy_fingerprint is rust-summaries-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Emit: declared summary manifest for demo_counter.rs
steps.artifact_contract: emit step must write {output_dir}/manifest.json holding one mumei.rust-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest keyed to the declared unit's context_key.
steps.verifier_gate: rust-summaries exits 0, writes manifest.json, and the manifest's schema_version and context_key appear in the step output.

steps.name: Check: manifest reuse check against a fresh derivation
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent rust-summaries-check {root_dir}/scenarios/rust_summaries/demo_counter.rs --manifest {output_dir}/manifest.json > {output_dir}/check_result.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/check_result.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"context_match": true' {output_dir}/check_result.json && grep -q '"stale": \[\]' {output_dir}/check_result.json && grep -q '"missing": \[\]' {output_dir}/check_result.json
steps.artifact_contract: check step must emit mumei.rust-summary-check/v1 partitioning every declared function as reusable, stale or missing against a fresh derivation.
steps.verifier_gate: rust-summaries-check exits 0 (checked via rc after redirecting output to check_result.json so the pipe cannot mask it) and the greps require context_match true plus empty stale/missing lists, so a refused or partially-stale partition fails the step instead of passing.

steps.name: rust-summaries-reuse: unchanged manifest is reused byte-for-byte
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent rust-summaries-reuse {root_dir}/scenarios/rust_summaries/demo_counter.rs --manifest {output_dir}/manifest.json > {output_dir}/reused_manifest.json 2> {output_dir}/reuse.log; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/reused_manifest.json; cat {output_dir}/reuse.log; test $rc -eq 0 && cmp {output_dir}/manifest.json {output_dir}/reused_manifest.json && echo 'rust-summaries-reuse: reused manifest is byte-identical'
steps.artifact_contract: reused_manifest.json is the rust-summaries-reuse merged manifest — with no source drift it reuses every unchanged summary and is byte-identical to manifest.json.
steps.verifier_gate: rust-summaries-reuse exits 0 and emits a manifest byte-identical to the declared one.

steps.name: Accept: strict whole-context gate on one declared summary
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent rust-summaries-accept {root_dir}/scenarios/rust_summaries/demo_counter.rs --manifest {output_dir}/manifest.json --function add > {output_dir}/accept_result.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/accept_result.json; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q '"accepted": true' {output_dir}/accept_result.json
steps.artifact_contract: accept step must emit mumei.rust-summary-accept/v1 and echo the declared summary only under an exact whole-context match; a stale manifest must refuse.
steps.verifier_gate: rust-summaries-accept exits 0 (checked via rc) and the grep requires accepted true, so an exit-0 refusal or a non-zero crash fails the step instead of passing.

intro: Step 1: rust-summaries emits a declared mumei.rust-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest for demo_counter.rs...
Step 2: rust-summaries-check re-derives summaries and partitions reusable/stale/missing functions...
Step 3: rust-summaries-accept echoes one function's declared summary under the strict whole-context gate...
narrative.before: No declared summary manifest exists for the Rust unit; every function is unassessed and nothing can be reused.
narrative.after: manifest.json records both function summaries keyed to the unit's context_key, the reuse check confirms both functions reusable, and the strict accept gate echoes add's declared summary.

pass.headline: Declared manifest emitted for demo_counter.rs
follow_up: schema_version mumei.rust-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 pins the manifest shape.
context_key binds the declared unit's bytes; each function is keyed by name.
add's return_dependencies [0, 1] and next's call into add are recorded as declared data.
Step 2: Checking the manifest against a fresh derivation...

pass.headline: Reuse check: both functions reusable
follow_up: context_match true and stale/missing empty — the manifest reproduces verbatim.
reusable lists both function names for the host's freshness choice.
Step 3: Accepting one declared summary under the strict gate...

pass.headline: Strict accept: add's declared summary authorized
follow_up: accepted true requires the manifest's context_key to match the fresh unit exactly.
The echoed summary is identical to the declared record — no forgery channel.
Demo complete: emit -> check -> accept closes the declared summary loop.
